recipes.name: rank system
recipes.use: A drop-in ranked progression system for UEFN. Players earn points for eliminations, lose points when they die, and climb 24 tiers from Bronze I to Unreal III. Progress is saved per player between sessions. It is made for island creators who want a ranked ladder with a ready-made HUD, rank-up screen
steps: Copy the `Rank_System` folder into your project (keep its folder structure).
Place **Rank System Device** in your level and an **Elimination Manager** device, then assign the Elimination Manager in the device's `GeneralSettings`.
Set the options in the device's Details panel (see `SETTINGS.md` for every setting and its default).
Optional: assign two Trigger devices in `TestSettings` to add or remove points while you test.
Launch a session. Turn on `DebugLoggingEnabled` to see the output in the Verse log (turn it off before publishing).
devices: rank_system_device: the device to place in the level
EliminationManager: a elimination_manager_device (Elimination Manager that reports kills and deaths (required).)
TestAddTrigger: a trigger_device (Trigger that adds points to the player who triggers it.)
TestSubtractTrigger: a trigger_device (Trigger that removes points from the player who triggers it.)
settings: PointsPerKill (int) = 15: Points given for each elimination.
PointsLostOnDeath (int) = 5: Points taken when the player dies (enter a positive number).
EnableRankUpCinematic (logic) = true: Show the rank-up screen when a player reaches a new tier.
EnableRankToast (logic) = true: HUD toast (RankUp / RankDown animations); independent from the rank-up cinematic
EnableLeaderboard (logic) = true: Show the live top-5 leaderboard.
Bronze_1_Points (int) = 100: Points needed to reach Bronze I.
Bronze_2_Points (int) = 250: Points needed to reach Bronze II.
Bronze_3_Points (int) = 450: Points needed to reach Bronze III.
Silver_1_Points (int) = 700: Points needed to reach Silver I.
Silver_2_Points (int) = 1000: Points needed to reach Silver II.
Silver_3_Points (int) = 1350: Points needed to reach Silver III.
Gold_1_Points (int) = 1750: Points needed to reach Gold I.
Gold_2_Points (int) = 2200: Points needed to reach Gold II.
Gold_3_Points (int) = 2700: Points needed to reach Gold III.
Platinum_1_Points (int) = 3250: Points needed to reach Platinum I.
Platinum_2_Points (int) = 3850: Points needed to reach Platinum II.
Platinum_3_Points (int) = 4500: Points needed to reach Platinum III.
Diamond_1_Points (int) = 5250: Points needed to reach Diamond I.
Diamond_2_Points (int) = 6050: Points needed to reach Diamond II.
Diamond_3_Points (int) = 6900: Points needed to reach Diamond III.
Elite_1_Points (int) = 7800: Points needed to reach Elite I.
Elite_2_Points (int) = 8750: Points needed to reach Elite II.
Elite_3_Points (int) = 9750: Points needed to reach Elite III.
Champion_1_Points (int) = 10800: Points needed to reach Champion I.
Champion_2_Points (int) = 11900: Points needed to reach Champion II.
Champion_3_Points (int) = 13050: Points needed to reach Champion III.
Unreal_1_Points (int) = 14250: Points needed to reach Unreal I.
Unreal_2_Points (int) = 15500: Points needed to reach Unreal II.
Unreal_3_Points (int) = 17000: Points needed to reach Unreal III.
TestAddAmount (int) = 150: Points added by the add trigger.
TestSubtractAmount (int) = 50: Points removed by the subtract trigger (enter a positive number).
43 material slots (Mat_*) default to the materials included: leave them unless you want other looks
wiring: EliminationManager: a elimination_manager_device (Elimination Manager that reports kills and deaths (required).)

# Rank_Leaderboard.verse
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Leaderboard Helpers  -  v5  (last modified: 2026-10-24)
#
# WHAT IT DOES
#   Helpers for the live leaderboard: picks the top players by points and writes or hides a row of the leaderboard widget.
#
# WHY IT IS USEFUL
#   Keeps the leaderboard code out of the device, so the device only has to say when to refresh.
#
# QUICK SETUP
#   1. Nothing to place: the Rank System Device uses this file.
#   2. Turn the leaderboard on or off with GeneralSettings > EnableLeaderboard on the device.
#   3. The rows come from the WBP_RankLeaderboard widget in the Rank_WBP folder.
#   4. Enable DebugLoggingEnabled on the device to see the output in the Verse log.
#
# GOOD TO KNOW
#   - Rows 1 to 5 are the top players; row 6 is the local player when they are outside the top 5.
#   - Players with the same points keep the order in which they were found.
#   - The widget has one set of fields per row (Vis_Row_1 ... Vis_Row_6), which is why each row is written separately.
#
# Author: mimmo_the_root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  __  __ ___ __  __ __  __  ___    _____ _   _ _____   ____   ___   ___ _____
# |  \/  |_ _|  \/  |  \/  |/ _ \  |_   _| | | | ____| |  _ \ / _ \ / _ \_   _|
# | |\/| || || |\/| | |\/| | | | |   | | | |_| |  _|   | |_) | | | | | | || |
# | |  | || || |  | | |  | | |_| |   | | |  _  | |___  |  _ <| |_| | |_| || |
# |_|  |_|___|_|  |_|_|  |_|\___/    |_| |_| |_|_____| |_| \_\\___/ \___/ |_|
#
#  Twitch:       https://www.twitch.tv/mimmo_the_root
#  YouTube:      https://www.youtube.com/@Mimmo_the_root
#  GitHub:       https://github.com/mimmo-the-root
#  X:            https://x.com/mimmo_the_root
#  Website:      https://mcf-studio.it
#  Fortnite:     https://www.epicgames.com/@root
#  Fortnite Creator Code: root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

using { /Verse.org/Simulation }
using { /Verse.org/Assets }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/UI }

using { Rank_WBP }

# --- 1. TOP-N SELECTION ---
# Repeated max-picking: O(rows * players). Ties go to the entry that appears first.
SelectTopEntries(AllEntries : []leaderboard_entry, Rows : int) : []leaderboard_entry =
    var TopEntries : []leaderboard_entry = array{}
    var UsedIdx : []int = array{}
    for (Slot := 0..Rows - 1):
        var BestIdx : int = -1
        var BestPts : int = -1
        for (Idx -> Entry : AllEntries):
            var AlreadyUsed : logic = false
            for (U : UsedIdx, U = Idx) do set AlreadyUsed = true
            if (AlreadyUsed = false, Entry.Points > BestPts):
                set BestIdx = Idx
                set BestPts = Entry.Points
        if (BestEntry := AllEntries[BestIdx]):
            set TopEntries += array{BestEntry}
            set UsedIdx += array{BestIdx}
    return TopEntries

# --- 2. ROW RENDERING ---
# Writes one entry into leaderboard row Slot (1-5 top rows, 6 = local player's own row)
ApplyLeaderboardRow(LB : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankLeaderboard, Slot : int, Entry : leaderboard_entry, IsYou : logic):void=
    if (Slot = 1):
        set LB.Vis_Row_1 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_1 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_1 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_1 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")
        set LB.Vis_You_1 = IsYou
    else if (Slot = 2):
        set LB.Vis_Row_2 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_2 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_2 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_2 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")
        set LB.Vis_You_2 = IsYou
    else if (Slot = 3):
        set LB.Vis_Row_3 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_3 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_3 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_3 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")
        set LB.Vis_You_3 = IsYou
    else if (Slot = 4):
        set LB.Vis_Row_4 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_4 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_4 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_4 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")
        set LB.Vis_You_4 = IsYou
    else if (Slot = 5):
        set LB.Vis_Row_5 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_5 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_5 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_5 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")
        set LB.Vis_You_5 = IsYou
    else if (Slot = 6):
        set LB.Vis_Row_6 = true
        if (Tex := Entry.Icon?) then set LB.Mat_Rank_6 = Tex
        set LB.Txt_Name_6 = PlayerToMessage(Entry.PlayerObj)
        set LB.Txt_Points_6 = ToMessage("{Entry.Points}")

# Hides one row of the leaderboard.
HideLeaderboardRow(LB : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankLeaderboard, Slot : int):void=
    if (Slot = 1) then set LB.Vis_Row_1 = false
    else if (Slot = 2) then set LB.Vis_Row_2 = false
    else if (Slot = 3) then set LB.Vis_Row_3 = false
    else if (Slot = 4) then set LB.Vis_Row_4 = false
    else if (Slot = 5) then set LB.Vis_Row_5 = false
    else if (Slot = 6) then set LB.Vis_Row_6 = false

# Rank_System_Device.verse
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rank System Device  -  v12  (last modified: 2026-10-24)
#
# WHAT IT DOES
#   Gives every player a competitive rank. Players earn points for eliminations and lose points on death,
#   climb 24 tiers from Bronze I to Unreal III, and their progress is saved between sessions.
#   Each player gets a rank HUD (rank name and icon, score, progress ring toward the next tier, floating +/- score),
#   a rank-up screen and an optional live top-5 leaderboard.
#
# WHY IT IS USEFUL
#   You do not have to build ranks, thresholds, saving, HUD, rank-up screen and leaderboard by hand: place one device and set a few values.
#
# QUICK SETUP
#   1. Place this device in your level.
#   2. Place an Elimination Manager device and assign it to GeneralSettings > EliminationManager.
#   3. GeneralSettings: PointsPerKill, PointsLostOnDeath, EnableRankUpCinematic, EnableRankToast, EnableLeaderboard.
#   4. RankThresholds: the points needed to reach each of the 24 tiers (the values must keep increasing).
#   5. TestSettings (optional): assign two Trigger devices to add or remove points (TestAddAmount, TestSubtractAmount).
#   6. RankMaterials (optional): the rank icon, highlight border and progress ring material of each rank group.
#   7. Launch a session. Enable DebugLoggingEnabled to see the output in the Verse log.
#
# GOOD TO KNOW
#   - The Elimination Manager is required: without it no points are given or taken.
#   - If the thresholds do not strictly increase, the default thresholds are used and a line is written to the log.
#   - The leaderboard shows the top 5 players plus the local player's own row when they are outside the top 5.
#   - Rank-ups that happen close together are merged into a single rank-up screen.
#   - The test triggers only work when a player triggers them (set Triggered By to the player).
#   - The widgets live in the Rank_WBP folder; keep that folder together with these Verse files.
#
# Author: mimmo_the_root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  __  __ ___ __  __ __  __  ___    _____ _   _ _____   ____   ___   ___ _____
# |  \/  |_ _|  \/  |  \/  |/ _ \  |_   _| | | | ____| |  _ \ / _ \ / _ \_   _|
# | |\/| || || |\/| | |\/| | | | |   | | | |_| |  _|   | |_) | | | | | | || |
# | |  | || || |  | | |  | | |_| |   | | |  _  | |___  |  _ <| |_| | |_| || |
# |_|  |_|___|_|  |_|_|  |_|\___/    |_| |_| |_|_____| |_| \_\\___/ \___/ |_|
#
#  Twitch:       https://www.twitch.tv/mimmo_the_root
#  YouTube:      https://www.youtube.com/@Mimmo_the_root
#  GitHub:       https://github.com/mimmo-the-root
#  X:            https://x.com/mimmo_the_root
#  Website:      https://mcf-studio.it
#  Fortnite:     https://www.epicgames.com/@root
#  Fortnite Creator Code: root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

using { /Fortnite.com/Devices }
using { /Fortnite.com/Characters }
using { /Fortnite.com/Game }
using { /Fortnite.com/UI }
using { /Verse.org/Simulation }
using { /Verse.org/Assets }
using { /Verse.org/Colors }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/UI }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/Diagnostics }

using { Rank_WBP }

rank_system_device<public> := class(creative_device):

    # --- 9. COLLAPSIBLE CATEGORIES (UEFN DETAILS PANEL) ---
    @editable
    # Main settings: Elimination Manager, points per kill and death, and the optional screens.
    GeneralSettings : general_settings = general_settings{}

    # Points needed to reach each of the 24 tiers.
    @editable
    # Points needed to reach each of the 24 tiers.
    RankThresholds : rank_thresholds = rank_thresholds{}

    # Optional test triggers that add or remove points without playing a match.
    @editable
    # Optional test triggers that add or remove points without playing a match.
    TestSettings : test_settings = test_settings{}

    # Rank icon, highlight border and progress ring materials of each rank group.
    @editable
    # Rank icon, highlight border and progress ring materials of each rank group.
    RankMaterials : rank_materials = rank_materials{}

    # Centralized logging switch (turn off before publishing)
    @editable
    # Centralized logging switch (turn off before publishing).
    DebugLoggingEnabled : logic = true

    # --- 10. CONSTANTS ---
    # Seconds between leaderboard refreshes (point changes are batched into one refresh)
    LeaderboardRefreshDelay : float = 0.5
    # Number of top rows shown; the extra row (6) shows the local player when outside the top
    LeaderboardTopRows : int = 5
    # Seconds the rank-up screen stays visible
    RankUpDisplaySeconds : float = 10.0
    # Seconds RankUp / RankDown stay at 1 on the HUD before being reset to 0
    RankChangeAnimSeconds : float = 3.0
    # Seconds RankUp / RankDown are held at 0 before being set to 1, so the widget always sees a 0 -> 1 change
    RankToastRestartSeconds : float = 0.1

    # --- 11. SYSTEM VARIABLES & MAPS ---
    RankTable : rank_table = rank_table{}
    # Rank HUD widget of each player.
    var ActiveRankHUDs : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem = map{}
    # Rank-up screen currently shown to each player.
    var ActiveSuccessWidgets : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankUpSuccess = map{}
    # Leaderboard widget of each player.
    var ActiveLeaderboards : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankLeaderboard = map{}
    # Pending rank-up per player: (rank index the player started from, latest rank index reached)
    var PendingRankUpgrades : [player]tuple(int, int) = map{}
    # True while a batched leaderboard refresh is already scheduled.
    var LeaderboardRefreshPending : logic = false
    # Latest toast id per player: an older toast must not reset the fields of a newer one
    var RankToastIds : [player]int = map{}

    # --- 1. LOGGING ---
    Log(LogMessage : string):void=
        if (DebugLoggingEnabled?):
            Print("[RankSystem] {LogMessage}")

    # --- 2. INITIALIZATION ---
    OnBegin<override>()<suspends>:void=
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("OnBegin: initializing rank system")

        BuildRanks()

        # Bind settings events
        GeneralSettings.EliminationManager.EliminationEvent.Subscribe(OnPlayerKilledSomeone)
        GeneralSettings.EliminationManager.EliminatedEvent.Subscribe(OnPlayerDied)

        # Bind test triggers
        TestSettings.TestAddTrigger.TriggeredEvent.Subscribe(OnTestAdd)
        TestSettings.TestSubtractTrigger.TriggeredEvent.Subscribe(OnTestSubtract)

        GetPlayspace().PlayerAddedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerAdded)
        GetPlayspace().PlayerRemovedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerRemoved)

        for (P : GetPlayspace().GetPlayers()):
            # Player joined: creates the HUD (and leaderboard) and shows their current rank.
            OnPlayerAdded(P)

    # Builds the rank table from the thresholds set in the Details panel (validated first)
    BuildRanks():void=
        var Thresholds : []int = DefaultRankThresholds

        Configured := array{
            0,
            RankThresholds.Bronze_1_Points, RankThresholds.Bronze_2_Points, RankThresholds.Bronze_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Silver_1_Points, RankThresholds.Silver_2_Points, RankThresholds.Silver_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Gold_1_Points, RankThresholds.Gold_2_Points, RankThresholds.Gold_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Platinum_1_Points, RankThresholds.Platinum_2_Points, RankThresholds.Platinum_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Diamond_1_Points, RankThresholds.Diamond_2_Points, RankThresholds.Diamond_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Elite_1_Points, RankThresholds.Elite_2_Points, RankThresholds.Elite_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Champion_1_Points, RankThresholds.Champion_2_Points, RankThresholds.Champion_3_Points,
            RankThresholds.Unreal_1_Points, RankThresholds.Unreal_2_Points, RankThresholds.Unreal_3_Points}
        if (ThresholdsAreValid[Configured]):
            set Thresholds = Configured
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("BuildRanks: using configured thresholds")
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("BuildRanks: configured thresholds are not strictly increasing, falling back to defaults")

        Icons : []?material = array{
            RankMaterials.Mat_Unranked,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Bronze_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Bronze_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Bronze_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Silver_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Silver_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Silver_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Gold_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Gold_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Gold_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Platinum_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Platinum_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Platinum_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Diamond_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Diamond_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Diamond_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Elite_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Elite_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Elite_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Champion_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Champion_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Champion_3,
            RankMaterials.Mat_Unreal_1, RankMaterials.Mat_Unreal_2, RankMaterials.Mat_Unreal_3}

        RankTable.Build(RankNames, RankGroups, Thresholds, Icons)
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("BuildRanks: {RankTable.Count()} ranks built")

    # Highlight-border material of a rank group (set in the Rank Materials category)
    GetHighlightMaterial(Group : string) : ?material =
        if (Group = "BRONZE") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Bronze
        if (Group = "SILVER") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Silver
        if (Group = "GOLD") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Gold
        if (Group = "PLATINUM") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Platinum
        if (Group = "DIAMOND") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Diamond
        if (Group = "ELITE") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Elite
        if (Group = "CHAMPION") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Champion
        if (Group = "UNREAL") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Unreal
        return RankMaterials.Mat_Highlight_Unranked

    # Countdown-ring material of a rank group (set in the Rank Materials category)
    GetCountdownMaterial(Group : string) : ?material =
        if (Group = "BRONZE") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Bronze
        if (Group = "SILVER") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Silver
        if (Group = "GOLD") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Gold
        if (Group = "PLATINUM") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Platinum
        if (Group = "DIAMOND") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Diamond
        if (Group = "ELITE") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Elite
        if (Group = "CHAMPION") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Champion
        if (Group = "UNREAL") then return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Unreal
        return RankMaterials.Mat_Countdown_Unranked

    # --- 3. TEST FUNCTIONS ---
    OnTestAdd(MaybeAgent : ?agent):void=
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("OnTestAdd: trigger fired")
        if (Agent := MaybeAgent?, Player := player[Agent]):
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("OnTestAdd: +{TestSettings.TestAddAmount}")
            # Adds (or removes) points and saves them, then updates the HUD, floating score, rank toast,
            # rank-up queue and leaderboard. Points never go below 0.
            AddRankPoints(Player, TestSettings.TestAddAmount)
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("OnTestAdd: trigger fired without a player (check the trigger's 'Triggered By' setting)")

    # Test trigger: removes TestSubtractAmount points from the player who triggered it.
    OnTestSubtract(MaybeAgent : ?agent):void=
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("OnTestSubtract: trigger fired")
        if (Agent := MaybeAgent?, Player := player[Agent]):
            var SubAmount : int = TestSettings.TestSubtractAmount
            if (SubAmount > 0) then set SubAmount = SubAmount * -1
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("OnTestSubtract: {SubAmount}")
            # Adds (or removes) points and saves them, then updates the HUD, floating score, rank toast,
            # rank-up queue and leaderboard. Points never go below 0.
            AddRankPoints(Player, SubAmount)
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("OnTestSubtract: trigger fired without a player (check the trigger's 'Triggered By' setting)")

    # --- 4. PLAYER CONNECTION & PERSISTENCE ---
    GetPlayerData(Player : player) : rank_save_data =
        if (Data := RankDataMap[Player]):
            return Data
        else:
            NewData := rank_save_data{}
            if (set RankDataMap[Player] = NewData){}
            return NewData

    # Player joined: creates the HUD (and leaderboard) and shows their current rank.
    OnPlayerAdded(Player : player):void=
        Data := GetPlayerData(Player)
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("OnPlayerAdded: player joined with {Data.RankPoints} points")

        if (PlayerUI := GetPlayerUI[Player]):
            # Main HUD
            NewWBP := Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem{}
            if (set ActiveRankHUDs[Player] = NewWBP){}
            PlayerUI.AddWidget(NewWBP, player_ui_slot{ZOrder := 90})
            # Writes the player's rank name, icon, score, colors, materials and progress into the HUD.
            RefreshUI(Player, NewWBP)

            # Leaderboard HUD (only if enabled in settings)
            if (GeneralSettings.EnableLeaderboard = true):
                NewLB := Rank_WBP.WBP_RankLeaderboard{}
                if (set ActiveLeaderboards[Player] = NewLB){}
                PlayerUI.AddWidget(NewLB, player_ui_slot{ZOrder := 80, InputMode := ui_input_mode.None})

            RequestLeaderboardUpdate()
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("OnPlayerAdded: no PlayerUI available for this player")

    # Player left: removes their widgets and clears every per-player record.
    OnPlayerRemoved(Player : player):void=
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("OnPlayerRemoved: player left")
        if (PlayerUI := GetPlayerUI[Player]):
            if (WBP := ActiveRankHUDs[Player]) then PlayerUI.RemoveWidget(WBP)
            if (LB := ActiveLeaderboards[Player]) then PlayerUI.RemoveWidget(LB)
            if (SuccessWBP := ActiveSuccessWidgets[Player]) then PlayerUI.RemoveWidget(SuccessWBP)

        var NewMap : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem = map{}
        for (K -> V : ActiveRankHUDs, K <> Player) do if (set NewMap[K] = V){}
        set ActiveRankHUDs = NewMap

        var NewLBMap : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankLeaderboard = map{}
        for (K -> V : ActiveLeaderboards, K <> Player) do if (set NewLBMap[K] = V){}
        set ActiveLeaderboards = NewLBMap

        # Forgets the queued rank-up of a player.
        ClearPendingUpgrade(Player)
        var NewToastMap : [player]int = map{}
        for (K -> V : RankToastIds, K <> Player) do if (set NewToastMap[K] = V){}
        set RankToastIds = NewToastMap
        RequestLeaderboardUpdate()

    # --- 5. COMBAT LOGIC (KILL / DEATH) ---
    OnPlayerKilledSomeone(MaybeKiller : ?agent):void=
        if (KillerAgent := MaybeKiller?, KillerPlayer := player[KillerAgent]):
            if (GeneralSettings.PointsPerKill > 0):
                # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                Log("OnPlayerKilledSomeone: +{GeneralSettings.PointsPerKill}")
                # Adds (or removes) points and saves them, then updates the HUD, floating score, rank toast,
                # rank-up queue and leaderboard. Points never go below 0.
                AddRankPoints(KillerPlayer, GeneralSettings.PointsPerKill)

    # Elimination Manager event: takes PointsLostOnDeath from the player who died.
    OnPlayerDied(VictimAgent : agent):void=
        if (VictimPlayer := player[VictimAgent]):
            var Penalty : int = GeneralSettings.PointsLostOnDeath
            if (Penalty > 0) then set Penalty = Penalty * -1

            if (Penalty < 0):
                # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                Log("OnPlayerDied: {Penalty}")
                # Adds (or removes) points and saves them, then updates the HUD, floating score, rank toast,
                # rank-up queue and leaderboard. Points never go below 0.
                AddRankPoints(VictimPlayer, Penalty)

    # --- 6. CORE RANK CALCULATION ---
    AddRankPoints(Player : player, Amount : int):void=
        Data := GetPlayerData(Player)
        var NewPoints : int = Data.RankPoints + Amount
        if (NewPoints < 0) then set NewPoints = 0
        AppliedDelta := NewPoints - Data.RankPoints
        OldIdx := RankTable.GetIndex(Data.RankPoints)
        NewIdx := RankTable.GetIndex(NewPoints)

        if (set RankDataMap[Player] = rank_save_data{ RankPoints := NewPoints, HighestRankAchieved := Data.HighestRankAchieved }){}
        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("AddRankPoints: requested {Amount}, applied {AppliedDelta}, total {NewPoints}")

        if (WBP := ActiveRankHUDs[Player]):
            # Writes the player's rank name, icon, score, colors, materials and progress into the HUD.
            RefreshUI(Player, WBP)
            # Only show the floating score when points actually changed
            if (AppliedDelta <> 0):
                spawn{ PlayFloatingScoreAnim(WBP, AppliedDelta) }
            # HUD toast when the rank changes (up or down); independent from the rank-up cinematic
            if (GeneralSettings.EnableRankToast = false):
                # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                Log("AddRankPoints: rank toast disabled in settings")
            else if (NewIdx > OldIdx):
                # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                Log("AddRankPoints: HUD rank-up animation {OldIdx} -> {NewIdx}")
                StartRankToast(Player, WBP, true)
            else if (NewIdx < OldIdx):
                # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                Log("AddRankPoints: HUD rank-down animation {OldIdx} -> {NewIdx}")
                StartRankToast(Player, WBP, false)

        CheckRankUpgrades(Player)
        RequestLeaderboardUpdate()

    # Writes the player's rank name, icon, score, colors, materials and progress into the HUD.
    RefreshUI(Player : player, WBP : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem):void=
        Data := GetPlayerData(Player)
        CurrentPoints := Data.RankPoints
        RankIdx := RankTable.GetIndex(CurrentPoints)

        if (Rank := RankTable.TierAt[RankIdx]):
            if (ValidIcon := Rank.Icon?) then set WBP.Mat_RankIcon = ValidIcon

            set WBP.Txt_RankName = ToMessage(Rank.Name)
            set WBP.Msg_CurrentScore = ToMessage("{CurrentPoints}")

            Colors := GetRankColors(Rank.ColorGroup)
            set WBP.Col_Text = Colors(0)
            set WBP.Col_Border = Colors(1)
            set WBP.Col_Theme = Colors(2)
            HighlightMat := GetHighlightMaterial(Rank.ColorGroup)
            if (Highlight := HighlightMat?) then set WBP.Mat_BorderFx = Highlight
            CountdownMat := GetCountdownMaterial(Rank.ColorGroup)
            if (Countdown := CountdownMat?) then set WBP.Mat_CountdownFx = Countdown

            if (Rank.IsMaxRank = true):
                set WBP.Show_TargetScore = false
                set WBP.Msg_TargetScore = ToMessage("")
                set WBP.Msg_ProgressPercent = ToMessage("MAX")
                set WBP.Progress = 1.0
            else if (NextRank := RankTable.TierAt[RankIdx + 1]):
                set WBP.Show_TargetScore = true
                Target := NextRank.MinPoints
                set WBP.Msg_TargetScore = ToMessage("{Target}")

                Base := Rank.MinPoints
                Diff := Target - Base
                Earned := CurrentPoints - Base

                # Diff is always > 0 with validated thresholds; guard anyway to avoid dividing by zero
                var Pct : float = 0.0
                if (Diff > 0):
                    set Pct = (Earned * 1.0) / (Diff * 1.0)
                if (Pct < 0.0) then set Pct = 0.0
                if (Pct > 1.0) then set Pct = 1.0

                set WBP.Progress = Pct
                if (IntPct := Floor[Pct * 100.0]):
                    set WBP.Msg_ProgressPercent = ToMessage("{IntPct}%")

    # Shows the floating +/- score: green for a gain, red for a loss.
    PlayFloatingScoreAnim(WBP : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem, Amount : int)<suspends>:void=
        var Msg : string = ""
        if (Amount > 0):
            set Msg = "+{Amount}"
            set WBP.Col_FloatingScore = color{R:=0.27, G:=1.0, B:=0.27}
        else:
            set Msg = "{Amount}"
            set WBP.Col_FloatingScore = color{R:=1.0, G:=0.03, B:=0.03}

        set WBP.Msg_FloatingScore = ToMessage(Msg)

        # Pulse the animation trigger
        set WBP.points = 1.0
        Sleep(0.1)
        set WBP.points = 0.0

    # Starts a HUD toast; a new toast supersedes any toast still running for the same player
    StartRankToast(Player : player, WBP : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem, IsUp : logic):void=
        ToastId : int = if (Prev := RankToastIds[Player]) then Prev + 1 else 1
        if (set RankToastIds[Player] = ToastId){}
        spawn{ PlayRankChangeAnim(Player, WBP, IsUp, ToastId) }

    # Restarts the RankUp / RankDown (0/1) parameter (0, short pause, 1) and sets it back to 0 after
    # RankChangeAnimSeconds, unless a newer toast took over in the meantime
    PlayRankChangeAnim(Player : player, WBP : Rank_WBP.WBP_RankSystem, IsUp : logic, ToastId : int)<suspends>:void=
        set WBP.RankUp = 0.0
        set WBP.RankDown = 0.0
        Sleep(RankToastRestartSeconds)
        if (IsUp = true):
            set WBP.RankUp = 1.0
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("PlayRankChangeAnim: RankUp = 1 (toast {ToastId})")
        else:
            set WBP.RankDown = 1.0
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("PlayRankChangeAnim: RankDown = 1 (toast {ToastId})")

        Sleep(RankChangeAnimSeconds)

        if (RankToastIds[Player] = ToastId):
            set WBP.RankUp = 0.0
            set WBP.RankDown = 0.0
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("PlayRankChangeAnim: RankUp / RankDown = 0 (toast {ToastId})")
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("PlayRankChangeAnim: toast {ToastId} superseded by a newer one, not resetting")

    # --- 7. RANK UPGRADE CINEMATIC QUEUE ---
    ClearPendingUpgrade(Player : player):void=
        var NewPendingMap : [player]tuple(int, int) = map{}
        for (Key -> Value : PendingRankUpgrades, Key <> Player) do if (set NewPendingMap[Key] = Value){}
        set PendingRankUpgrades = NewPendingMap

    # Records a rank-up. Consecutive rank-ups before the cinematic plays are merged into one (start -> latest)
    CheckRankUpgrades(Player : player):void=
        Data := GetPlayerData(Player)
        CurrentIdx := RankTable.GetIndex(Data.RankPoints)

        if (CurrentIdx > Data.HighestRankAchieved):
            StartIdx : int = if (Pending := PendingRankUpgrades[Player]) then Pending(0) else Data.HighestRankAchieved
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("CheckRankUpgrades: rank up {StartIdx} -> {CurrentIdx}")
            if (set PendingRankUpgrades[Player] = (StartIdx, CurrentIdx)){}
            if (set RankDataMap[Player] = rank_save_data{ RankPoints := Data.RankPoints, HighestRankAchieved := CurrentIdx }){}
            spawn{ ProcessRankQueue(Player) }

    # Plays pending cinematics one at a time per player; a second call while one is running just returns,
    # because the running loop picks up whatever was queued in the meantime
    ProcessRankQueue(Player : player)<suspends>:void=
        if (ActiveSuccessWidgets[Player]):
            return

        loop:
            if (RankTuple := PendingRankUpgrades[Player]):
                # Forgets the queued rank-up of a player.
                ClearPendingUpgrade(Player)
                if (GeneralSettings.EnableRankUpCinematic = true):
                    # Shows the rank-up screen for RankUpDisplaySeconds, then removes it.
                    ShowRankUpSuccess(Player, RankTuple(0), RankTuple(1))
                else:
                    # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
                    Log("ProcessRankQueue: rank-up cinematic disabled in settings, skipping")
            else:
                break

    # Shows the rank-up screen for RankUpDisplaySeconds, then removes it.
    ShowRankUpSuccess(Player : player, OldRankIdx : int, NewRankIdx : int)<suspends>:void=
        if (PlayerUI := GetPlayerUI[Player]):
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("ShowRankUpSuccess: {OldRankIdx} -> {NewRankIdx}")
            SuccessWidget := Rank_WBP.WBP_RankUpSuccess{}
            if (set ActiveSuccessWidgets[Player] = SuccessWidget){}

            if (OldRank := RankTable.TierAt[OldRankIdx], NewRank := RankTable.TierAt[NewRankIdx]):
                set SuccessWidget.Msg_UpgradeLevel = ToMessage("RANK UP: {NewRank.Name}")
                if (ValidOldIcon := OldRank.Icon?) then set SuccessWidget.Mat_OldRank = ValidOldIcon
                if (ValidNewIcon := NewRank.Icon?) then set SuccessWidget.Mat_NewRank = ValidNewIcon

            # InputMode None: the cinematic must never steal mouse/controls during combat
            PlayerUI.AddWidget(SuccessWidget, player_ui_slot{InputMode := ui_input_mode.None, ZOrder := 200})

            # Pulse the animation trigger
            set SuccessWidget.PlayAnim = true
            Sleep(0.1)
            set SuccessWidget.PlayAnim = false

            Sleep(RankUpDisplaySeconds)

            PlayerUI.RemoveWidget(SuccessWidget)
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("ShowRankUpSuccess: cinematic widget removed")
            var NewMap : [player]Rank_WBP.WBP_RankUpSuccess = map{}
            for (Key -> Value : ActiveSuccessWidgets, Key <> Player) do if (set NewMap[Key] = Value){}
            set ActiveSuccessWidgets = NewMap
        else:
            # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
            Log("ShowRankUpSuccess: no PlayerUI available, skipping cinematic")

    # --- 8. LIVE LEADERBOARD ---
    # Batches many point changes into a single refresh every LeaderboardRefreshDelay seconds
    RequestLeaderboardUpdate():void=
        if (GeneralSettings.EnableLeaderboard = true, LeaderboardRefreshPending = false):
            set LeaderboardRefreshPending = true
            spawn{ DeferredLeaderboardRefresh() }

    # Waits LeaderboardRefreshDelay, then refreshes the leaderboard once.
    DeferredLeaderboardRefresh()<suspends>:void=
        Sleep(LeaderboardRefreshDelay)
        set LeaderboardRefreshPending = false
        # Collects every active player, picks the top rows and writes them to each player's leaderboard.
        RefreshLeaderboard()

    # Collects every active player, picks the top rows and writes them to each player's leaderboard.
    RefreshLeaderboard():void=
        var AllEntries : []leaderboard_entry = array{}

        for (P : GetPlayspace().GetPlayers(), P.IsActive[]):
            Pts := GetPlayerData(P).RankPoints
            RIdx := RankTable.GetIndex(Pts)
            var RIcon : ?material = false
            if (R := RankTable.TierAt[RIdx], ValidIcon := R.Icon?) then set RIcon = option{ValidIcon}

            set AllEntries += array{leaderboard_entry{PlayerObj := P, Points := Pts, RankIdx := RIdx, Icon := RIcon}}

        # Writes to the Verse log only when DebugLoggingEnabled is on.
        Log("RefreshLeaderboard: {AllEntries.Length} players ranked")

        TopEntries := SelectTopEntries(AllEntries, LeaderboardTopRows)

        for (TargetPlayer -> LB : ActiveLeaderboards):
            # Top rows
            for (Slot -> Entry : TopEntries):
                var IsYou : logic = false
                if (Entry.PlayerObj = TargetPlayer) then set IsYou = true
                ApplyLeaderboardRow(LB, Slot + 1, Entry, IsYou)

            # Hide unused top rows
            for (Slot := TopEntries.Length..LeaderboardTopRows - 1):
                HideLeaderboardRow(LB, Slot + 1)

            # Extra row (6): the local player's own position when outside the top rows
            var InTop : logic = false
            for (Entry : TopEntries, Entry.PlayerObj = TargetPlayer) do set InTop = true

            var MyEntry : ?leaderboard_entry = false
            for (Entry : AllEntries, Entry.PlayerObj = TargetPlayer) do set MyEntry = option{Entry}

            if (InTop = false, Mine := MyEntry?):
                var Ahead : int = 0
                for (Entry : AllEntries, Entry.Points > Mine.Points) do set Ahead += 1
                # Ties beyond the top rows must never display a rank inside the top rows
                MyRankNumber : int = if (Ahead + 1 > LeaderboardTopRows) then Ahead + 1 else LeaderboardTopRows + 1
                ApplyLeaderboardRow(LB, LeaderboardTopRows + 1, Mine, false)
                set LB.Txt_MyRankNumber = ToMessage("{MyRankNumber}")
            else:
                HideLeaderboardRow(LB, LeaderboardTopRows + 1)

# Rank_Table.verse
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rank Table  -  v5  (last modified: 2026-10-24)
#
# WHAT IT DOES
#   Rank table logic: the default names, groups and point thresholds of the 24 tiers, the table that maps points to a tier,
#   the threshold check and the color palette of each rank group.
#
# WHY IT IS USEFUL
#   Keeps the rank maths separate from the device and the UI, so it is easy to read and to change.
#
# QUICK SETUP
#   1. Nothing to place: the Rank System Device uses this file.
#   2. To change the default thresholds edit DefaultRankThresholds, or better use the RankThresholds category of the device.
#   3. To change a rank group's colors edit GetRankColors (text, border, theme).
#   4. Enable DebugLoggingEnabled on the device to see the output in the Verse log.
#
# GOOD TO KNOW
#   - There are 24 tiers: the names, groups and thresholds arrays must always have the same length.
#   - The last tier is the maximum rank: it has no next target.
#   - Colors are (text, border, theme) in that order and use values from 0 to 1.
#
# Author: mimmo_the_root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  __  __ ___ __  __ __  __  ___    _____ _   _ _____   ____   ___   ___ _____
# |  \/  |_ _|  \/  |  \/  |/ _ \  |_   _| | | | ____| |  _ \ / _ \ / _ \_   _|
# | |\/| || || |\/| | |\/| | | | |   | | | |_| |  _|   | |_) | | | | | | || |
# | |  | || || |  | | |  | | |_| |   | | |  _  | |___  |  _ <| |_| | |_| || |
# |_|  |_|___|_|  |_|_|  |_|\___/    |_| |_| |_|_____| |_| \_\\___/ \___/ |_|
#
#  Twitch:       https://www.twitch.tv/mimmo_the_root
#  YouTube:      https://www.youtube.com/@Mimmo_the_root
#  GitHub:       https://github.com/mimmo-the-root
#  X:            https://x.com/mimmo_the_root
#  Website:      https://mcf-studio.it
#  Fortnite:     https://www.epicgames.com/@root
#  Fortnite Creator Code: root
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

using { /Verse.org/Colors }
using { /Verse.org/Simulation }
using { /Verse.org/Assets }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/UI }

# --- 1. DEFAULT RANK DEFINITIONS ---
RankNames : []string = array{
    "UNRANKED",
    "BRONZE I", "BRONZE II", "BRONZE III",
    "SILVER I", "SILVER II", "SILVER III",
    "GOLD I", "GOLD II", "GOLD III",
    "PLATINUM I", "PLATINUM II", "PLATINUM III",
    "DIAMOND I", "DIAMOND II", "DIAMOND III",
    "ELITE I", "ELITE II", "ELITE III",
    "CHAMPION I", "CHAMPION II", "CHAMPION III",
    "UNREAL I", "UNREAL II", "UNREAL III"}

# Color group of each tier (used to pick the palette).
RankGroups : []string = array{
    "UNRANKED",
    "BRONZE", "BRONZE", "BRONZE",
    "SILVER", "SILVER", "SILVER",
    "GOLD", "GOLD", "GOLD",
    "PLATINUM", "PLATINUM", "PLATINUM",
    "DIAMOND", "DIAMOND", "DIAMOND",
    "ELITE", "ELITE", "ELITE",
    "CHAMPION", "CHAMPION", "CHAMPION",
    "UNREAL", "UNREAL", "UNREAL"}

# Default points needed for each tier (used when the configured ones are not valid).
DefaultRankThresholds : []int = array{
    0,
    100, 250, 450,
    700, 1000, 1350,
    1750, 2200, 2700,
    3250, 3850, 4500,
    5250, 6050, 6900,
    7800, 8750, 9750,
    10800, 11900, 13050,
    14250, 15500, 17000}

# --- 2. THRESHOLD VALIDATION ---
# Fails unless every threshold is strictly greater than the previous one
ThresholdsAreValid(T : []int)<transacts><decides>:void=
    for (Idx -> Value : T, Idx > 0, Prev := T[Idx - 1]):
        Value > Prev

# --- 3. RANK TABLE ---
rank_table := class:
    # All the tiers, lowest first.
    var Ranks : []rank_tier = array{}

    # Builds the tier list from parallel arrays (all the same length); the last tier is the max rank
    Build(Names : []string, Groups : []string, Thresholds : []int, Icons : []?material):void=
        LastIdx := Names.Length - 1
        var Built : []rank_tier = array{}
        for (Idx -> Name : Names, Group := Groups[Idx], MinPts := Thresholds[Idx], Icon := Icons[Idx]):
            IsMax : logic = if (Idx = LastIdx) then true else false
            set Built += array{rank_tier{Name := Name, MinPoints := MinPts, Icon := Icon, ColorGroup := Group, IsMaxRank := IsMax}}
        set Ranks = Built

    # Number of tiers.
    Count():int = Ranks.Length

    # Returns the tier at an index (fails if the index is out of range).
    TierAt(Idx : int)<transacts><decides>:rank_tier = Ranks[Idx]

    # Highest tier whose MinPoints the given points reach
    GetIndex(Points : int):int =
        var FoundIndex : int = 0
        for (Idx -> RankData : Ranks):
            if (Points >= RankData.MinPoints):
                set FoundIndex = Idx
        return FoundIndex

# --- 4. RANK COLORS ---
# Returns (text color, border color, theme color) for a rank group
GetRankColors(Group : string) : tuple(color, color, color) =
    if (Group = "UNRANKED") then return (color{R:=0.50, G:=0.50, B:=0.50}, color{R:=0.29, G:=0.29, B:=0.29}, color{R:=0.69, G:=0.69, B:=0.69})
    if (Group = "BRONZE") then return (color{R:=0.80, G:=0.49, B:=0.19}, color{R:=0.47, G:=0.26, B:=0.11}, color{R:=1.0, G:=0.60, B:=0.30})
    if (Group = "SILVER") then return (color{R:=0.75, G:=0.75, B:=0.75}, color{R:=0.40, G:=0.44, B:=0.47}, color{R:=0.90, G:=0.94, B:=0.96})
    if (Group = "GOLD") then return (color{R:=1.0, G:=0.84, B:=0.0}, color{R:=0.65, G:=0.45, B:=0.0}, color{R:=1.0, G:=0.94, B:=0.41})
    if (Group = "PLATINUM") then return (color{R:=0.0, G:=0.89, B:=1.0}, color{R:=0.0, G:=0.56, B:=0.63}, color{R:=0.36, G:=1.0, B:=1.0})
    if (Group = "DIAMOND") then return (color{R:=0.31, G:=0.76, B:=0.96}, color{R:=0.08, G:=0.45, B:=0.64}, color{R:=0.49, G:=0.86, B:=1.0})
    if (Group = "ELITE") then return (color{R:=0.0, G:=0.78, B:=0.32}, color{R:=0.0, G:=0.52, B:=0.18}, color{R:=0.22, G:=1.0, B:=0.53})
    if (Group = "CHAMPION") then return (color{R:=1.0, G:=0.07, B:=0.57}, color{R:=0.66, G:=0.0, B:=0.37}, color{R:=1.0, G:=0.30, B:=0.72})
    if (Group = "UNREAL") then return (color{R:=0.61, G:=0.15, B:=0.69}, color{R:=0.35, G:=0.03, B:=0.43}, color{R:=0.83, G:=0.41, B:=1.0})
    return (color{R:=1.0, G:=1.0, B:=1.0}, color{R:=1.0, G:=1.0, B:=1.0}, color{R:=1.0, G:=1.0, B:=1.0})

recipes.name: weighted loot box
recipes.use: A button opens a loot box and gives one item picked by weight, so rare items come rarely and the odds are one table to edit.
steps: Create a Verse device from weighted_loot_box.verse and place it in the level.
Place one Button device and one Item Granter device for every possible reward, each granter holding one item.
In the Details panel assign OpenButton, add every granter to Granters, and give Weights the same number of entries (a bigger number means more often).
Build the Verse, launch a session and press the button many times.
Turn DebugLoggingEnabled off before publishing.
devices: weighted_loot_box: the Verse device to place
Button device: the player presses it to open the box
Item Granter device: one for each possible reward
settings: Weights (int array): the chance of each granter is its weight divided by the sum of all weights
Each granter: one item, set to grant to the agent who interacted
wiring: Granters: the item granters, in the same order as Weights

recipes.name: ordered objectives
recipes.use: Triggers must be touched in order, for quest steps or course checkpoints; each player keeps own progress and out of order touches are ignored.
steps: Create a Verse device from ordered_objectives.verse and place it in the level.

recipes.name: course checkpoints
recipes.use: Respawn points for an obstacle course: the player returns to the last checkpoint touched, per player, with no code.
steps: Place a Player Checkpoint device at the start of each stage, in course order.
Set each one so it saves the respawn point for the player who touches it and keep them enabled from the start.
Place a Damage Volume or a kill zone under the course so a fall sends the player to the last checkpoint.
Launch, touch two checkpoints, fall, and confirm the respawn is at the last one; try with two players.
devices: Player Checkpoint device: one for each stage
Damage Volume device: below the course
settings: Each checkpoint: enabled at game start, respawn point for the player who touches it
Respawn time: short (about two seconds)
recipes.verify: Falling returns the player to the last checkpoint touched within about two seconds, never to the start unless no checkpoint was touched; two players keep separate checkpoints.
